description: Developing compiler-assisted memory access monitoring tools using LLVM/ Clang to analyze Bengaluru and optimize runtime memory behavior.
Implementing instrumentation passes to detect memory access inefficiencies including redundant loads, false sharing, and poor locality.
Exploring and applying loop optimizations, prefetching strategies, and redundancy elimination techniques to improve memory performance.
Benchmarking optimizations against real workloads to quantify speedup and memory efficiency gains.
experience.title: PRISM Intern – Compiler Optimization Research

description: Developed a vision-based indoor localization framework for GPS-denied environments using
smartphone camera and IMU sensors.
Designed a localization pipeline using Visual-Inertial SLAM concepts and feature matching
(ORB-SLAM3-inspired) for accurate indoor positioning.
Built an intent-aware navigation workflow enabling natural language destination queries
and context-aware POI recommendations.
Integrated AR-based navigation for real-time indoor guidance with zero external hardware
requirements.
projects.project_name: Hybrid Vision-Based Indoor Localization & Intent-Aware Navigation Framework

description: Engineered a next-generation AI-powered exam proctoring system with a privacy-first
design, combining computer vision and behavioral analysis.
Built a full-stack application with a React frontend and Flask REST API backend, supporting
Admin/ Student authentication and end-to-end exam management.
Designed a relational database schema in MySQL to manage books, members, and
borrowing records, enforcing data consistency and referential integrity.
Built a structured backend API enabling real-time operations — book issuance, returns, and
search — with dynamic server-side rendering.
